title: 信号发生器里的 50 Ω，探头的接地夹
summary: 同一台信号发生器，接上小电阻，波形就变小：它里面串着 50 Ω。再故意把探头的接地夹夹错一次。
description: 信号发生器（正弦、1 kHz、幅度 1 V）接一个 50 Ω 负载：输出被它自己的 50 Ω 和负载分压。探头的接地夹只能夹在 GND 上。

cards.title: 换一个电阻，波形变小了
text: 先搭出上一课的电路：信号发生器、**`100 kΩ`** 电阻、一个探头。
然后只把电阻换成 **`50 Ω`**，信号发生器一个旋钮都不碰。
屏幕上的波形怎么了？信号发生器的设定没变，为什么？

cards.title: 信号发生器里串着一个电阻
text: - 信号发生器里面不是一个理想的电压，而是**理想波形 + 一个 50 Ω 电阻**串在一起——就像 1.10 里 9 V 电池里有 1.5 Ω。
- 接上负载 R，这 50 Ω 和 R 组成一个**分压器**。例如负载 1 kΩ 时：
![](fig:inside)
- R 比 50 Ω 大得多时几乎看不出；R 和 50 Ω 差不多时，波形就明显变小。
- 示波器测的是**针尖 − 接地夹**。接地夹要夹在 GND 上，读数才是“这一点对 GND”。
![](fig:clip)

cards.title: 夹错一次，再量分压
text: - 先**故意把接地夹夹错**：夹在和针尖同一列上。看「诊断」标签和屏幕。
- 改回来以后，再给信号加一个偏置。直流偏置也要经过那 50 Ω。
- 先在测量题里写预测，再读屏幕下面的读数。

cards.title: 带走
text: - **信号发生器 = 理想波形 + 50 Ω。** 负载越小，输出被分掉得越多；直流偏置也一样。
- **接地夹只夹 GND。** 示波器只会测“针尖 − 接地夹”。
- **真实仪器**：很多信号发生器默认按“接 50 Ω 负载”显示幅度。接到高阻电路上，实际幅度是显示值的两倍——把输出设成 High-Z 显示才对。
- 真实示波器的接地夹都连到大地。夹在信号上，会把那一点直接短路到地。
- 下一课：两个探头一起用，比较两个电压谁先到。

caption.text: OUT、COM 左边是信号发生器里面：理想波形 v_s 串 50 Ω。接上负载 R_L，输出 v_out 是 50 Ω 和 R_L 分压的结果。

i18n.en: Left of OUT/COM is the inside of the generator: an ideal waveform v_s in series with 50 Ω. With a load R_L, the output v_out is what the 50 Ω and R_L divide it to.

caption.text: 针尖插在信号那一列，接地夹夹在 GND 轨上：屏幕画的是“针尖 − 接地夹”，也就是这一列对 GND 的电压。

i18n.en: The tip sits in the signal column, the ground clip on the GND rail: the screen draws tip − clip, the voltage of that column relative to GND.

en.title: The 50 Ω inside the generator, and the probe's ground clip
en.summary: The same generator gives a smaller wave once a small resistor is connected: there are 50 Ω inside it. Then put the probe's ground clip in the wrong place, on purpose, once.
en.description: A function generator (sine, 1 kHz, 1 V amplitude) with a 50 Ω load: its own 50 Ω and the load divide the output. The probe's ground clip goes on GND only.
en.compare: **Compare**: 1 V amplitude set (2 Vpp); with the 50 Ω load the divider gives 50 / (50 + 50) = 1/2: **1.0 Vpp**, R_int ≈ **50 Ω** worked back; with +1 V offset the DC part is halved too, average **0.5 V**. With the clip on the tip's point the screen shows a flat **0 V** line.
steps: **Function generator**: red clip **`a5`**, black clip **`tn5`**. Keep sine, **`1 kHz`**, amplitude **`1 V`**, offset **`0 V`**.
**Resistor R1**: **`b5`** and **`tn12`**, set to **`100 kΩ`**. Remember how tall the wave is.
Click R1 and change it to **`50 Ω`** (custom) in Properties. Leave the generator alone. What happened to the wave?

**Clip it wrong once, on purpose**: delete the probe (select it, press Delete) and place it again: tip **`c5`**, ground clip **`d5`** — the tip's own column, not GND. Read the Diagnostics tab: what does it say? What is left on the screen?
Fix it: delete the probe and place it again, tip **`c5`**, ground clip **`tn8`**.
Click the generator and set the **offset** to **`+1 V`**. How far did the wave move up? Write your prediction in the questions first.
Set the offset back to **`0 V`**.
Press **Check my circuit** and answer the questions from the scope (set the offset to `+1 V` for the offset question).
hints: Think of the generator as "ideal waveform + 50 Ω", forming a divider with the load.
50 Ω against 50 Ω splits exactly in half: the AC part and the DC offset alike.
The scope draws tip minus clip. With both on the same point the difference is 0.
tests: With the 50 Ω load the amplitude drops

measurements.ask: With the 50 Ω load and 1 V amplitude set: CH1 peak-to-peak Vpp
measurements.explain: 2 Vpp × 50 / (50 + 50) = 1 Vpp: the generator's own 50 Ω and the load take half each.

measurements.ask: From your reading, work back to the resistance inside the generator: R_int = 50 Ω × (2 Vpp / your Vpp − 1)
measurements.explain: The divider gives Vpp = 2 × 50 / (50 + R_int); solve for R_int. A 1 Vpp reading gives exactly 50 Ω.
The offset is DC and is halved by the 50 Ω and 50 Ω as well: 0.5 V.

measurements.ask: With the ground clip in the same column as the tip, what was on the screen?
measurements.explain: Tip − clip = the same point minus itself = 0. A real scope would also short that point to ground.

cards.title: Swap a resistor and the wave shrinks
text: First rebuild the last lesson's circuit: generator, a **`100 kΩ`** resistor, one probe.
Then change only the resistor, to **`50 Ω`**, without touching a single generator knob.
What happened to the wave? The generator's settings didn't change — so why?

cards.title: A resistor sits inside the generator
text: - Inside, the generator is not an ideal voltage but an **ideal waveform in series with a 50 Ω resistor** — just like the 1.5 Ω inside the 9 V battery in 1.10.
- Connect a load R and the 50 Ω and R form a **voltage divider**. With a 1 kΩ load, for example:
![](fig:inside)
- With R much larger than 50 Ω you hardly notice; with R near 50 Ω the wave clearly shrinks.
- The scope measures **tip − ground clip**. The clip has to be on GND for the reading to mean "this point relative to GND".
![](fig:clip)

cards.title: Clip it wrong once, then measure the divider
text: - First **put the ground clip in the wrong place on purpose**: in the same column as the tip. Look at the Diagnostics tab and the screen.
- After fixing it, add an offset to the signal. The DC offset has to pass the 50 Ω too.
- Write your prediction in each question first, then read the numbers under the screen.

cards.title: Take away
text: - **A generator = an ideal waveform + 50 Ω.** The smaller the load, the more of the output is lost; the DC offset too.
- **The ground clip goes on GND only.** A scope only ever measures "tip − clip".
- **Real instruments**: many generators display the amplitude assuming a 50 Ω load. Into a high-resistance circuit the real amplitude is twice the display — set the output to High-Z.
- A real scope's ground clips all go to mains earth. Clipped onto a signal, it shorts that point straight to ground.
- Next: two probes at once, to see which of two voltages arrives first.

tests.name: 接上 50 Ω 负载后幅度变小

compare: **对比**：设定 1 V 幅度（2 Vpp），接 50 Ω 负载后分压 50 / (50 + 50) = 1/2：峰峰值 **1.0 Vpp**，反算 R_int ≈ **50 Ω**；偏置 +1 V 时直流部分也被分掉一半，平均值 **0.5 V**。接地夹和针尖在同一点时，屏幕是 **0 V** 的直线。

measurements.ask: 接着 50 Ω 负载、设定幅度 1 V：CH1 的峰峰值 Vpp
measurements.explain: 2 Vpp × 50 / (50 + 50) = 1 Vpp：信号发生器自己的 50 Ω 和负载各分一半。

measurements.ask: 用你的读数反算信号发生器里面的电阻：R_int = 50 Ω × (2 Vpp / 你的 Vpp − 1)
measurements.explain: 分压 Vpp = 2 × 50 / (50 + R_int)，解出 R_int。读数是 1 Vpp 时正好 50 Ω。

measurements.ask: 把偏置调到 +1 V：CH1 的平均值
measurements.explain: 偏置是直流，同样被 50 Ω 和 50 Ω 分掉一半：0.5 V。

measurements.ask: 接地夹夹在和针尖同一列时，屏幕上是什么？
measurements.explain: 针尖 − 接地夹 = 同一点减同一点 = 0。真实示波器还会把这一点短路到地。

steps.text: 单击 R1，在「属性」里把阻值改成 **`50 Ω`**（自定义）。信号发生器不动。波形变成了什么样？
**故意夹错一次**：删掉探头（选中它，按「删除」），重新放：针尖 **`c5`**，接地夹 **`d5`**——和针尖同一列，不是 GND。看「诊断」标签：它说什么？屏幕上剩下什么？
改回来：删掉探头，重新放，针尖 **`c5`**、接地夹 **`tn8`**。
单击信号发生器，把**偏置**调到 **`+1 V`**。波形往上移了多少？先在测量题里写预测再看。
点**「检查我的电路」**，读示波器完成测量题（偏置那题先把偏置调到 `+1 V`）。

hints: 把信号发生器看成“理想波形 + 50 Ω”，和负载组成一个分压器。
50 Ω 对 50 Ω 正好分一半：交流部分和直流偏置都一样。
示波器画的是针尖减接地夹。两者在同一点上，差就是 0。
